selected_skill.page_contract: The reader should understand that projected climate zones expand and move poleward by 2070 because the same Natural Earth projection and the same 70 fixed cities compare present and projected Köppen classes in place.
selected_skill.reader_question: Where do projected 2070 Köppen subclasses differ from the present map, and what happens to the sampled cities?
selected_skill.intended_conclusion: 45 of 70 cities change subclass and cold-class cities fall from 16 to 1 in the RCP8.5 projection.

counting_policy.reason: The excluded files are shared runtime chassis, canonical records, raw/generated scientific evidence or test products; treating their size as optimizable author logic would create a false reduction.

readability_changes: Separated author logic from frozen city, climate-grid and provenance records before measuring characters.
Centralized abortable listener ownership without changing event types, order or teardown behavior.
Kept projection coefficients, palette, class domains, collision candidates and canonical state explicit.
Shared signed one-decimal temperature formatting between tooltips and city aria labels.
Returned decoded grid states as a named object and kept present/future image derivation in one readable loop.
Removed only CSS behavior already supplied by the chassis or browser defaults.

units.map_position: Natural Earth projected pixels on a 1584x900 logical map

channels.position: fixed projected city longitude/latitude and climate raster cell
channels.opacity: selected five-class focus versus retained context
channels.connection: tooltip arrow relates the same city record from present subclass to projected subclass

encoding_contract.missing_policy: Raster DN 0 remains transparent; city records are complete and none are dropped.
encoding_contract.projection_note: 2070 is an RCP8.5 ensemble projection of 2071-2100 conditions, not an observation.

layout_and_render_hashes.all_five_focus_states: Baseline and candidate present/future source bitmap hashes are identical for tropical, arid, temperate, cold and polar focus.

tests.name: formal archive immutability
tests.evidence: Both author and all seven recorded chassis/evidence SHA256 values still match the baseline manifests.

tests.name: original and candidate data suites
tests.evidence: Both verify 70 cities, 45 subclass changes, 31 major changes, cold 16 to 1, projection error bounds and canonical GeoJSON. The candidate suite additionally verifies RLE bounds and exact expanded present/future hashes.

tests.name: canonical layout and bitmap equivalence
tests.evidence: Decoded grid hashes, 58 collision-label placements, 70 semantic city button positions/labels and all four source Canvas pixel hashes are exactly equal.

tests.name: all focus classifications
tests.evidence: Present and future Canvas hashes match baseline for all, tropical, arid, temperate, cold and polar states.

tests.name: fixed-state pixels
tests.evidence: Present, temperate focus, Oslo tooltip, boundary-city Auckland tooltip, 1280 present, reduced future, fixed 1000ms midpoint, complete future, rapid reversal and failed-grid fallback all measured baseline/candidate RGB AE=0.

tests.name: transition and rapid switch
tests.evidence: The fixed midpoint has future opacity 0.5; complete future is 1. Rapid future-to-present reversal preserves the browser reversal rule from 0.3 to 0.1 at the tested playheads, with AE=0.

tests.name: representative and boundary cities
tests.evidence: Oslo and Auckland expose identical subclass, one-decimal Celsius and signed-delta evidence. Auckland tooltip remains inside the stage at x=1241.6875 through right=1533.6875.

tests.name: mouse and touch
tests.evidence: Mouse year selection and zone hover, touch year selection and native city/legend controls update the same canonical year/focus state as baseline.

tests.name: keyboard traversal
tests.evidence: ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End and 1/2 year navigation match baseline. Seventy Tab presses visit 70 unique city buttons from Oslo through Melbourne; the next focus is Present Day. Escape clears tooltip and focus.

tests.name: selection, clear and reset
tests.evidence: All five zone selections, invalid-focus normalization, Escape clearing and double reset return canonical present/no-focus state. Two settled reset frames measured AE=0.

tests.name: resize and clipping
tests.evidence: 1600x900 and 1280x720 retain a 1584x900 logical map, stage exactly fits the viewport, document scroll dimensions equal the viewport and visible evidence remains inside the stage.

tests.name: reduced motion
tests.evidence: Reduced motion resolves future opacity directly to 1 with the settled 2070 status and an AE=0 baseline/candidate frame.

tests.name: dispose, pagehide and reinitialize
tests.evidence: Destroy and pagehide abort listeners, unregister resize callbacks and shrink all four backing stores to 1x1. Reload recreates four map canvases, 70 city controls and canonical initial state.

tests.name: resource failure
tests.evidence: Forced climate-grid failure returns ready=false, exposes the textual fallback, retains 70 city records and 58 labels, and matches baseline pixels at AE=0. The failed request and explicit diagnostic error are expected in this forced path.

tests.name: WebGL applicability
tests.evidence: The implementation is deterministic Canvas 2D and does not create or depend on a WebGL context.

tests.name: normal runtime errors and requests
tests.evidence: Normal, interaction, focus, resize, reduced-motion and lifecycle runs reported zero page errors, console errors and failed requests.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Minify identifiers, CSS or the Natural Earth projection.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would violate the no-minify rule and obscure the page's decisive quantitative algorithm.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Collapse palette, class domains, city fields or label candidates into opaque positional tables.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would reduce Agent readability and make units/domain/collision rules harder to audit.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Remove some city buttons, labels, tooltip evidence or focus layers.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would reduce semantic access or visual evidence and violate the 70-record/annotation baseline.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Downsample, requantize or regenerate climate grids for a smaller payload.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would change canonical evidence and is outside author-layer optimization.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Replace mathematical rendering with PNG, video or another static artifact.
unadopted_compression.reason: Would remove the real projection, category focus, accessible inspection and deterministic state model.

unadopted_compression.proposal: Claim generated/raw data size as author-code savings.
unadopted_compression.reason: This would misrepresent the token target and hide that the evidence is unchanged.

cross_audit.scope: Independent chart-reference audit of formal immutability, author metrics, climate data/projection/classification, fixed states, inputs, reduced motion, double reset, resize, fallback, pagehide disposal and reload.
cross_audit.revision: Restored ordinary object-property spacing where the first candidate had compacted it; algorithms and runtime behavior are unchanged.

risks.risk: Canvas text metrics can vary across browser/font environments.
risks.mitigation: Baseline and candidate were paired in the same Chromium/font environment; placement and label bitmap hashes are recorded in addition to screenshots.

risks.risk: The staging candidate depends on formal chassis and evidence through relative symlinks.
risks.mitigation: All targets and hashes are recorded; promotion must preserve or materialize them deliberately.

notes: The formal archive was not edited and the candidate was not promoted.
No city record, climate cell, label, visual layer, interaction state or evidence unit was removed.
